Measuring the Perception Gap for Tibetan Cultural Symbols in AI-Generated Art', Electronics 2026, 15(1), 15: Lihua Bai is the last author at School of Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence, Wuhan University of Technology; no ORCID is recorded. The MDPI article page (mdpi.com), its PDF (mdpi-res.com, also over the PDF reader's 20MB limit) and the ResearchGate mirror are all blocked by the egress proxy, so the printed Author Information block was read through WebSearch page-text extraction. Three separate WebSearch runs reproduced the same block - Yuhan Liu tracyliu@hust.edu.cn, Yiran Qiao ethanqiao@whut.edu.cn, Anshu Hu anshuhu@whut.edu.cn, correspondence liuyj626@163.com - and every one of them showed Lihua Bai (affiliation 4) with NO email beside the name. Also searched '"Lihua Bai" "whut.edu.cn"'; that returned only a domain-level claim ('has an email address at whut.edu.cn'), which is a masked/pattern statement and not a printed address, so it was rejected. The only concrete namesake found was Lihua BAI of the Department of Mathematics, Nankai University (ResearchGate profile) - a different field and institution with no anchor to this paper, so rejected. Refused to construct an address from the co-authors' whut.edu.cn pattern.
